meta.title: Consent documents
meta.description: Publish new versions of the privacy policy, the terms and the messages consent.

consentAdmin.title: Consent documents
consentAdmin.lead: Each change is a new version. Published versions never change, so everyone's consent points at the exact text they saw.

denied.title: Only staff admins can open this page
denied.body: Publishing consent documents is for staff admins and super admins. Ask a super admin if you need it.

consentAdmin.currentPublisherGone: Version {version}, published {date} by an account that no longer exists.
consentAdmin.none: Nothing published yet. Until you publish version 1, the page shows the text in the code.

title.label: Title
title.error: Enter a title of up to 200 characters.

source.label: Text
source.hint: Short-version points go first, each on a line starting with a dash. Start each section with two hash signs and its title. Write **bold** for strong words and [words](/page) for a link.

form.failed: Something went wrong on our side. Nothing was published. Please try again.

errors.no_sections: Add at least one section, starting with two hash signs and its title.
errors.text_before_first_section: Only short-version points, on lines starting with a dash, can come before the first section.
errors.invalid_section_id: Section ids use lowercase letters and hyphens only.
errors.duplicate_section_id: Two sections have the same id. Give one of them another title or id.
errors.unclosed_strong: Bold text needs two stars at both ends.
errors.invalid_link: Links go to a page on this site (/page), a section (#id) or an https address.
errors.unknown_fact: We don't know that fact. Use legalName, email, phone, address, grievanceOfficerName or grievanceOfficerEmail.
errors.unclosed_fact: Close the fact with two closing braces.
errors.dangling_escape: A backslash at the end of a line has nothing to escape.
errors.invalid_document: The text breaks a rule we can't point to a line for. Check the links and section ids.

consentAdmin.versionPublisherGone: Published {date} by an account that no longer exists.
